lines.2: Subaru and I headed home together.
lines.5: 「The girls in your class invited you to karaoke today, didn't they? You sure you didn't want to go?」
lines.7: 「Besides, I haven't been working lately, so I'm broke.」
lines.8: 「Then let's live modestly and buy sixty-yen ice pops on the way home.」
lines.10: 「It's nice and easy when it's just the two of us.」
lines.13: 「No! Wrong! Stop it! Don't fade the screen to black!」
lines.14: My childhood friends had some bizarre tricks up their sleeves.
lines.15: I almost let the story end right there.
